name: cloudflare
description: Reads the zones and DNS records in a Cloudflare account: DNS host and plan per domain, the hostnames apps are missing, links to the machines the records point at, and records that point at nothing you run.

commands.zones: Propose dns and plan for every zone in the account, and add the domains the file lacks. Never removes one.
commands.records: Map every DNS record to the node it points at: propose hostnames for apps and HTTP links for nodes, and report records that point at retired machines or unknown addresses
